import collections
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data_dict):
    if not data_dict:
        return None, "The distribution is uniform."

    categories = list(data_dict.keys())
    counts = np.asarray(list(data_dict.values()), dtype=float)

    avg_count = float(np.mean(counts))
    is_uniform = np.all(np.abs(counts - avg_count) <= 1e-5)
    message = "The distribution is uniform." if is_uniform else "The distribution is not uniform."

    bins = min(10, len(np.unique(counts)))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(counts, bins=bins, edgecolor="black", alpha=0.75)

    # Label x-ticks with category names as requested.
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(categories)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(categories, rotation=45, ha="right")

    ax.set_xlabel("Categories")
    ax.set_ylabel("Counts")
    ax.set_title("Distribution of Category Counts")

    return ax, message
